name: Requisition Outcomes
summary: Result Outcome Failure by 5+ Refusal or a dangerous source; the attempt may create Heat, debt or misinformation. Failure by 1-4 Available with a complication such as delay, substitute, debt, limited charges or damaged condition. Success Available as requested for the mission or agreed period. Success by 5+ Improved condition, extra supplies, faster delivery or discreet paperwork. Natural 20 No automatic miracle; add favourable provenance, a useful introduction or future access.
